svg.title: Lag-specific tangent references
svg.desc: At each of the current, 25-volume, and 50-volume lags, a reconstructed correlation is compared with its reconstructed fold-trained reference to produce a tangent matrix. Six-by-six excerpts are shown from the full 39-by-39 matrices. All three tangents become 2340 coordinates, clipped and reduced to 64 whitened PCA scores.
